components.name: Name Field
components.description: The single arrival field with a visible label and calm graphite fill.
components.html: <label class="ds-name-label" for="ds-name">Your name</label><input id="ds-name" class="ds-name" placeholder="What should we call you?" autocomplete="given-name" maxlength="40" />
components.css: .ds-name-label{display:block;font-family:'Geist Variable', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;margin:0 0 11px;color:#c3c7cd}.ds-name{display:block;font-family:'Geist Variable', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;width:100%;height:54px;border:1px solid #41454c;background:#191b1f;border-radius:10px;padding:0 16px;color:#eeefec;font-size:15px;caret-color:#eeefec}.ds-name::placeholder{color:#9298a1;opacity:1}.ds-name:focus{border-color:#9ca29a}.ds-name:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eeefec;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Library Search
components.description: Search the real Plex library; focus surrounds the field as a whole.

components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:0 13px;height:40px;border:1px solid #40454d;border-radius:8px;color:#aab2bc;width:min(100%,280px)}.ds-search input{font-family:'Geist Variable', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;width:100%;background:transparent;color:#eeefec;border:0;min-width:0;outline:none;font-size:12px;caret-color:#eeefec}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:#9298a1;opacity:1}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid #c9d0c5;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-search{width:100%;height:44px}.ds-search input{font-size:16px}}

components.name: Library Filter
components.description: Quiet content-type filter; a filled graphite state identifies the selection.

components.name: Poster Item
components.description: Documented missing-poster treatment. Runtime titles and images come from Plex; this specimen uses an explicit placeholder label.
components.css: .ds-poster{font-family:'Geist Variable', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:0;transition:background-color 160ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)),color 160ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)),transform 120ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1));display:block;min-width:0;width:100%;text-align:left;background:transparent;padding:0;color:#eeefec;}.ds-poster:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #eeefec;outline-offset:4px}.ds-poster:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.97)}.ds-poster:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.45}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-poster:hover:not(:disabled){}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-poster{transition-duration:.01ms}}.ds-poster-image{aspect-ratio:2/3;position:relative;width:100%;background:#292d33;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a4adba}.ds-poster>strong{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:10px;font-weight:500}.ds-poster-detail{display:block;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#a0a8b3;margin-top:4px}.ds-poster-play{opacity:0;position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.42);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#f1f2ed;transition:opacity 160ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1))}.ds-poster:focus-visible .ds-poster-play{opacity:1}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-poster:hover .ds-poster-play{opacity:1}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-poster-image{border-radius:6px}.ds-poster>strong{font-size:11px}.ds-poster-detail{font-size:10px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-poster-play{transition-duration:.01ms}}

narrative.overview:
Near-black graphite surrounds the movie and faces. Soft off-white Geist keeps the interface legible without competing with media. The room feels quiet and personal: a small wordmark, short labels, and controls that earn their space.

The shipped interface uses one type family, restrained rounded rectangles, real Plex artwork, and functional Phosphor icons. Its density comes from the people and library content. It does not add decorative panels or a marketing layer around the call.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces with soft off-white text.
Movie and camera imagery establish the visual hierarchy.
Compact controls and short, sentence-case labels.
Brief state transitions; playback chrome recedes during viewing.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Keep interface color tied to an action or state. Artwork supplies the room's color; its hues do not become interface accents.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Geist throughout the interface. Distinguish hierarchy through size, weight, spacing, and color rather than another display face.

rules.name: The Media Depth Rule
rules.body: Use gradients where captions or controls overlap imagery. Use tonal contrast for ordinary controls and shadow for overlays that sit above the room.

dos: **Do** keep the movie and people ahead of persistent interface chrome.
**Do** use self-hosted Geist and functional Phosphor icons.
**Do** use real Plex artwork and metadata in the library.
**Do** keep keyboard focus visible and icon actions explicitly named.
**Do** preserve the mobile camera strip and the seek control's 44px interaction height.
donts: **Don't** use poster colors as permanent interface accents.
**Don't** apply the modal shadow to ordinary controls or camera tiles.
**Don't** add decorative panels or marketing typography around the room.
**Don't** leave playback controls permanently visible while a movie is playing.
